content.text: The gh credential helper only serves the **active** account — it returned nothing for `johndemic`. So per-repo `credential.username` won't work. Let me check the pieces for a config-dir approach.

input.command: echo "--- token retrieval per user ---"; gh auth token -u johndemic >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "johndemic: OK" || echo "johndemic: FAIL"; gh auth token -u tableforone >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "tableforone: OK" || echo "tableforone: FAIL"; echo "--- direnv? ---"; which direnv 2>&1; echo "--- zshrc chpwd/gh refs ---"; grep -nE "chpwd|GH_TOKEN|GH_CONFIG_DIR|direnv" ~/.zshrc 2>&1 | head -20; echo "--- keyring setting ---"; cat ~/.config/gh/config.yml 2>/dev/null | head -30
